description: Smart-search filters for the Rate Schedule tab ONLY. One config file per tab, because oj-sp-smart-search renders a chip for EVERY filter the loaded config declares — suggestion-filters does NOT gate that row. Each `field` IS the endpoint's literal query-param name (see reportCriterion.ENDPOINT_PARAMS); a field that is not a real param yields a chip that filters nothing, because the views ignore unknown params silently. This set is deliberately CURATED, not exhaustive — the endpoint accepts more params than are offered. Not offered: scheduleCode (dropped by request); scheduleName (redundant with it); effectiveFrom/effectiveTo (no date filter type). There is deliberately NO Class chip even though the view DECLARES a className param: the server ignores it — className=ZZZ still returns all 131 rows, while the same param genuinely filters on yard-stock, pending-approval-lines and onhand-qty. Class remains reachable through free-text q (q=Earthmoving returns exactly the 25 Earthmoving rows). Restore the chip once the view honours the param.
